design: redesign after the independent review of PR #67: structured payload only, typed text merged locally, detection-only tripwire (the scrubbing module of the first version was removed)
method: one mutation at a time; each anchor asserted to occur exactly once; the bound tests of the mutated side are run (backend pytest offline per PRB-002, frontend vitest JSON reporter)
hash_basis: sha256 of the UTF-8 text with LF line endings

P1_payload_bypassed.reintroduces: the request's findings go to the prompt builder as received

P2_builder_prints_free_text.reintroduces: the prompt builder prints the clinical indication again

P3_payload_copies_free_text.reintroduces: the free-text fields copied into the payload

P4_any_label_accepted.reintroduces: labels outside the device's vocabulary sent

P5_counts_not_coerced.reintroduces: any value printed where a count is expected (free text through number fields)

P6_any_sex_sent.reintroduces: any sex value sent, shown as Female

P7_exact_age_sent.reintroduces: the exact age sent instead of the 5-year band

P8_no_90_or_older.reintroduces: ages of 90 and over sent in 5-year bands (93 -> 90-94)

P9_payload_in_system_prompt.reintroduces: the system prompt no longer the fixed template

T1_tripwire_removed.reintroduces: no check of the final prompt

T2_name_check_removed.reintroduces: the patient's names, contact, city and street not looked for

T4_device_words_reported.reintroduces: a patient named White blocks every draft ('Deep White Matter')

T5_pair_check_removed.reintroduces: names made only of the device's words ('Black White') not found

T6_record_number_check_removed.reintroduces: the record number not looked for

T9_record_phone_check_removed.reintroduces: the patient's short phone forms ('01 40400') not found

T11_generic_email_removed.reintroduces: other people's e-mail addresses not found

T12_generic_date_removed.reintroduces: dates with a year not found

T14_long_number_removed.reintroduces: long and phone-like numbers not found

T17_format_characters_kept.reintroduces: a soft hyphen or zero-width character hides a name

T20_particle_surname_dropped.reintroduces: a surname such as Do or Le never looked for

T21_length_cap_removed.reintroduces: no cap on the scanned text

T22_quadratic_email_pattern.reintroduces: the e-mail pattern of the first version (quadratic time)

F1_route_needs_no_segmentation.reintroduces: a request without patient reference reaches the provider

F2_route_does_not_authorize.reintroduces: any caller drafts a report on any patient's segmentation

F3_unreadable_record_ignored.reintroduces: the provider is called although the patient record could not be read

F4_incomplete_record_accepted.reintroduces: a record without record number, name or birth date accepted

F5_service_sends_without_identifiers.reintroduces: the service builds and sends a prompt without the patient's identifiers

F6_assistant_omits_segmentation.reintroduces: the assistant's report tool sends no segmentation (every draft refused)

M1_typed_text_not_merged.reintroduces: the clinician's typed text missing from the draft

M2_entry_before_disclaimer.reintroduces: the typed text placed before the RC-006 disclaimer

M3_model_not_told.reintroduces: the model is not told that the clinician's text is added by the application

L1_raw_findings_logged.reintroduces: the request's findings written to the log

L2_prompt_logged.reintroduces: the prompt written to the log

L3_counts_not_logged.reintroduces: no record of what was withheld

C1_false_header_claim.reintroduces: the service header claims de-identification again
